core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khalis is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pure, sincere, clear”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khalis corresponds to the Arabic form خالص (Arabic root خ ل ص (kh-l-ṣ); خَالِص (Khāliṣ)). Its core sense is pure, sincere, clear. Khalis is Arabic خَالِص (Khāliṣ) 'pure, sincere, clear', from the root خ ل ص (kh-l-ṣ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave the broken form خَلِيس; the correct form is خَالِص. The source gloss 'Pure, clean, virtuous' is broadly consistent.
